# GET /api/v1/orgs/{org}/actions/runners/{runner_id}

Get a specific org-level runner by ID

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer · **ID:** `ep-049`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| org | path | string | True |
| runner_id | path | integer | True |

**Headers:** `Authorization`

## Response

**200** — ActionRunner

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `id` | int64 | Runner ID |
| `name` | string | Runner name |
| `status` | string | online or offline |
| `busy` | bool | Whether runner is actively running a job |
| `disabled` | bool | Whether runner is disabled |
| `ephemeral` | bool | Whether runner is ephemeral |
| `labels` | []ActionRunnerLabel | Runner labels |

- **404** — Runner not found or not editable in this org context
- **403** — User is not org owner or site admin

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| Organization ownership required for all actions endpoints (secrets, variables, runners) | authorization | User is not org owner AND not site admin |
| Runner access is scoped by EditableInContext - runner must belong to the org | authorization | ownerID > 0 && runner.OwnerID != ownerID |
| Runner status is computed from LastOnline/LastActive timestamps, not stored | business_logic | LastOnline > 1 minute ago = offline; LastActive > 10 seconds ago = idle; else = active |
